name: courtvault
description: Catalog website and mobile app for basketball trading card collectors

scripts.test: pnpm -r --if-present test && pnpm test:db && pnpm test:functions
scripts.lint:functions: cd supabase/functions && deno lint && deno fmt --check
scripts.db:reset: supabase db reset && SUPABASE_LOCAL=1 pnpm import:checklist data/checklists/2025-26-topps-basketball.csv data/checklists/2025-26-topps-chrome.csv data/checklists/2025-26-topps-chrome-updates.csv data/checklists/2025-26-topps-hoops.csv data/checklists/2025-26-topps-finest.csv data/checklists/2025-26-topps-cosmic-chrome.csv data/checklists/2025-26-topps-chrome-sapphire.csv data/checklists/2025-26-topps-midnight.csv data/checklists/2025-26-bowman.csv data/checklists/DEMO-2026-27-topps-basketball.csv && SUPABASE_LOCAL=1 node ./scripts/apply-dev-overrides.mjs
scripts.db:types: supabase gen types typescript --local --schema public > packages/shared/src/database.types.ts && prettier --write packages/shared/src/database.types.ts
